rpicollege projectsTechnologyraspberry pilinux

I’ve become a huge fan of Raspberry Pi(RPi) and I was wondering the options it provides to students to do their college/University projects.
So let me just give some headsup and then you are on own feet with your creativity.

Basics



  • Buy Raspberry Pi. I prefer the ModelB with 512MB RAM - Link

  • Extend it - Edimax Wifi adapter, Wireless Mouse and Keyboard

  • Bread board
